claims.statement: A post-formation matching variable can induce a nonzero matched F-J contrast although the total causal effect of F on J is zero.
claims.domain: Finite binary SCMs in EXACT_RESULTS.json; not persons or phenomenal states.
all_premises: F independent of U before treatment
J has no causal dependence on F
the declared conditioning or target weighting is used
claims.proof_or_source: Exact enumeration of OR and XOR models; established collider/selection theory credited in SOURCE_SCOPE.md.
claims.counterexamples_and_limits: Pre-treatment adjustment is not covered; natural equal XOR weights cancel. The claim is existential, not that every post-treatment match is biased.
claims.thought_experiment_role: Shows how apparent formation sensitivity can be manufactured without a formation effect.

claims.statement: When the formation effect is fully mediated by a matched/clamped variable, the total effect can be nonzero while every controlled direct effect at fixed mediator value is zero; observational same-mediator overlap may also fail.
all_premises: the equations define the admitted finite model
total and controlled effects retain their intervention meanings
claims.proof_or_source: Direct potential-outcome/intervention table in EXACT_RESULTS.json; direct/indirect-effect antecedents credited.
claims.counterexamples_and_limits: Does not say every ease or agency variable is a mediator; its causal role must be independently established.
claims.thought_experiment_role: Blocks interpreting a zero matched residual as absence of formation-dependent organization.

claims.statement: A residual formation claim must either target a randomized total effect with only pre-formation adjustment or satisfy every Route-C joint-intervention, positivity, route-preservation, same-event and endpoint premise.
claims.domain: Prospective bodily/action-familiarity judgment studies using the A3X/A3Z endpoint contract.
claims.proof_or_source: Definition of the estimands plus A4A-C1/C2 failure witnesses and primary causal-inference sources.
claims.counterexamples_and_limits: No actual study presently discharges all Route-C premises; this is not a completed-graph rule.
claims.thought_experiment_role: Turns an underspecified five-way match into a falsifiable installability gate.

claims.statement: A valid formation effect supports formation sensitivity of the installed judgment organization only; it does not identify H_way, validate C1, create a basal-experience gate, or select an exclusive owner.
claims.domain: The declared A4A application under inherited C1/R157/R173/A3Z distinctions.
claims.proof_or_source: A3Z proxy countermodel and R157/R173 semantic residual.
claims.counterexamples_and_limits: An independent phenomenal-identity bridge could add evidence but is not supplied here.
claims.thought_experiment_role: Keeps organizational history inside experience without equating judgment, concept, report and feeling.
